integrity: Proof reconstructed from the definitions and Propositions 3.2 and 5.3 of arXiv:2504.00171v1. The active-factor embedding and the coordinatewise product construction were checked directly; no independent audit or computational certificate was used.
scientific_limitations: Finite Cartesian products only. The proof covers shadowing maps, L-shadowing maps, and self-tuning pseudo-orbit maps; it does not prove reflection for the stronger shift-invariant or dynamically-invariant levels. The stated proof uses the max product metric and a common standard weighted sequence metric.
title: Finite products are exact for the first three shadowing-map levels
